https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/actions/runs/16363875134/job/46236815168

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved error messages and validation when setting the current version from environment variables.
  * Enhanced compatibility by replacing a non-standard array sorting method with a widely supported one.

## Walkthrough

The updates introduce a helper function for parsing and validating the `GP_VERSION` environment variable, replacing inline logic with clearer error handling and encapsulation. Additionally, array sorting in a test utility is refactored to use `.sort()` instead of `.toSorted()`, maintaining the same sorting behavior.

## Changes

| File(s)                                              | Change Summary                                                                                   |
|------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| packages/core/utils/compatibility.ts                 | Added `parseCurrentVersion` function for validating `GP_VERSION`; updated `CURRENT_VERSION` initialization to use it. |
| packages/core/utils/test.ts                          | Replaced `.toSorted()` with `.sort()` for array sorting in the `deepEqual` function.             |
